c74object.name: evi_svfs_lto_extras
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_svfs_lto_extras.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_svfs_lto_extras.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_svfs_lto_extras.genexpr file also requires:
evi_approx.genexpr
About this File:
This file contains some all-in-one multimode LTO SVF filters for using in GenExpr.

entry.name: svfLtoMulti ( )
entry.description:
All-in-one simultaneous outputs multimode SVF filter
In 1: type=input: v0, Audio input
In 2: type=input: cutoff, Cutoff frequency in Hz
In 3: type=input: Q, Q
Return 1: Low, Lowpass output
Return 2: Band, Bandpass output
Return 3: High, Highpass output
Return 4: Notch, Notch output

entry.name: svfLtoSingle ( )
entry.description:
The same as 'svfLtoMulti()' but with a single filter choice output
In 1: type=input: v0, Audio input
In 2: type=input: cutoff, Cutoff frequency in Hz
In 3: type=input: Q, Q
In 4: type=input: filt, (int) filter: 0=lowpass, 1=bandpass, 2=highpass, 3=notch
Return 1: Selected Filter, Filtered audio output

entry.name: svfLtoBell ( )
entry.description:
A standalone Bell filter
In 1: type=input: v00, Audio input
In 2: type=input: cutoff, Cutoff frequency in Hz
In 3: type=input: gain, Gain in dB
In 4: type=input: Q, Q
Return 1: Bell Filter, Filtered audio output

entry.name: svfSinMulti ( )
entry.description:
All-in-one simultaneous outputs multimode SVF filter solved for sin() (theoretically more stable low-end response when modulating but in always-64-bit-doubles environment of Gen should not make much difference)
In 1: type=input: X, Audio input
In 2: type=input: cutoff, Cutoff frequency in Hz
In 3: type=input: damp, Q normalised 0..1
Return 1: Low, Lowpass output
Return 2: Band, Bandpass output
Return 3: High, Highpass output
Return 4: Peak, Peak output
Return 5: Notch, Notch output

entry.name: svfSinSingle ( )
entry.description:
The same as 'svfSinMulti()' but with a single filter choice output
In 1: type=input: X, Audio input
In 2: type=input: cutoff, Cutoff frequency in Hz
In 3: type=input: damp, Q normalised 0..1
In 4: type=input: filt, (int) filter: 0=lowpass, 1=bandpass, 2=highpass, 3-peak, 4=notch
Return 1: Selected Filter, Filtered audio output

entry.name: inputMixingSvfCoefficients ( )
entry.description:
Param rate coefficients calculator for the 'inputMixing' SVF
In 1: type=input: cutoff, Cutoff frequency in Hz
In 2: type=input: res, Resonance normalised 0..1
Return 1: g0, g0 coefficient
Return 2: g1, g1 coefficient
Return 3: g2, g2 coefficient
Return 4: g3, g3 coefficient

entry.name: inputMixingSvfLoop ( )
entry.description:
Audio loop to match with 'inputMixingSvfCoefficients()' for the 'inputMixing' SVF
In 1: type=input: vlow, Lowpass audio input
In 2: type=input: vband, Bandpass audio input
In 3: type=input: vhigh, Highpass audio input
In 4: type=input: g0, g0 coefficient
In 5: type=input: g1, g1 coefficient
In 6: type=input: g2, g2 coefficient
In 7: type=input: g3, g3 coefficient
Return 1: Mixed Output, Filtered audio output

entry.name: inputMixingSvf ( )
entry.description:
All audio rate version of the 'inputMixing' SVF
In 1: type=input: vlow, Lowpass audio input
In 2: type=input: vband, Bandpass audio input
In 3: type=input: vhigh, Highpass audio input
In 4: type=input: cutoff, Cutoff frequency in Hz
In 5: type=input: res, Resonance normalised 0..1
Return 1: Mixed Output, Filtered audio output
